title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic plans to set a valuation range this week and begin trading on Thursday or Friday of next week, the Journal reported. Investors will look to Anthropic’s valuation to gauge the strength of the AI boom.
